data.name: Rozanna
data.gender_notes: Rozanna is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'rosana', meaning 'dew of Roses'. In Greek mythology, the goddess of love, Aphrodite, was often depicted with a rose in her hand. Roses symbolize love, beauty, and new beginnings. The name Rozanna carries the meaning “Rose, delicate” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rozanna usually hope their child will grow to embody rose, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the delicate beauty and love found in nature and the divine.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rozanna total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
data.cultural_impact: The name Rozanna is of Greek origin and is rich in cultural meaning, reminding us of the ancient Greek civilization and their Goddess of Love, Aphrodite. Rozanna's name symbolizes the timeless beauty, grace, and romance associated with this deity. The name Rozanna also carries the reminder of the exquisite and perfumed roses from the mythological tales of Greek mythology.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rozanna holds great spiritual significance as it symbolizes renewal, rebirth, and new beginnings. Its connection to the rose, which is a common symbol of love and Christian virtues like purity, humility, and self-sacrifice, adds depth to its spiritual meaning. Rozanna's name embodies the belief that even in the midst of the harshest realities, God can bring new life and growth, like the dew on a rose petal.
